plan.title: Extend submission time twice by 15 minutes

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ without recreating or searching for the event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case setup.
Navigate to the RFQ stage where the submission-time setting is available.
Apply the first 15-minute custom extension and verify the new end is 15 minutes after the original end.
Apply the second 15-minute extension and verify it adds 15 minutes to the already extended end, yielding E plus 30 minutes cumulatively.
